working_definition: P15 'tail' of differentiating neurons attached to the T2/T3/60 (probably T2a) clusters; the authors' call is 'probably immature T2/T2a/T3 neurons'.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T neuron (Hormann et al., 2020).

justification: FBbt has no immature T2, T2a or T3 terms. T2 (FBbt:00003728), T2a (FBbt:00003729) and T3 (FBbt:00003730) are all T neurons, and 'immature T neuron' is the precursor of an adult T neuron. Verification flagged because of the authors' 'probably' hedge.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that develops from an optic neuroblast and will become an adult optic lobe neuron.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Less specific than immature T neuron.

recommendation: Broad match to immature T neuron; members T2, T2a, T3.
